finding: Concrete possible progress deadlock in cf_camp_focus; completed screen also shows severe inactivity and acquisition collapse.
classification: Source/control-flow liveness blocker, separately from conservative forecast quality. No crash/fault is required.

scope.parent_full: Stopped/incomplete; no efficacy conclusion from partial full-stage outcomes.

minimal_control_flow_scenario.conditions: Interior translated coordinates may be used. Melee Ryth at(5,0), no dash, legal one-step movement, full1200HP, basicStrength50/Focus100, two damaged cardinally adjacent elks T(0,0) HP1000 and U(1,0) HP2000, each strength60/range3. No healthy near helper, visible enemy, bag/shop/emergency motive or other earlier-action trigger. Group is current target; not expired/cooldown.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.selected_target: Farm chooses weakest live T, distance5. Both camps are damaged, so engaged=true and farm committed=true.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.forecast: cf_contact advances hypothetically to(4,0). T is distance4 and U distance3. With self my_dps=50*1.125+100*1.5/8=75, cf_forecast charges U for ceil((1000+2000)/75)-1=39 rounds, focused=2340. Budget=1200*(1-0.18)=984, so it rejects.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.no_legal_handler_action: At actual(5,0), camp distances5 and4 exceed range3, so here=0 and escape search is skipped. cast_offense(T) immediately rejects target distance5>SPELL_RANGE4; basic_attack rejects5>meleeRange1. No movement or camp damage occurs in this handler.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.no_exit: engaged=true disables the only drop_target condition. cf_focus_safe returns false, and farm immediately returns. Next local decision repeats if the world state persists.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.retarget_suppression: Damaged camp => committed=true, suppressing ordinary periodic target refresh. Damaged U at distance4 satisfies awake_camp_near (CAMP_RANGE+1), even if the actual camp has since slept; this also disables P_UNSTICK30. The blocker does not rely on a cooldown remaining unready.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.original_behavior: Original engaged groups bypass the fresh-pull squad gate and reach engage(), which can step toward the attack ring; this focus guard removes that progress path.
minimal_control_flow_scenario.qualification: A source-proven possible stable branch, not an executed synthetic engine match. External allies/enemies, changed health/state, emergency decisions or a different target can break the loop; not every rejection is permanent.

completed_screen_mechanisms.interpretation: Lower incoming camp damage accompanies much lower clear/gem/gold throughput and only a small death-rate reduction. Deposit ratio is nearly unchanged. Counter maxima are sampled lower bounds; this subtraction describes handler activity at common periodic snapshots, not all champion-turn activity.

completed_case.candidate_bodies0_and1: Each native monsterDamageDone0, earnedGold0, collectedGems0, deaths0; each took60 camp damage. Body2 did only500 monster damage/24 collected gems.
completed_case.limitation: No retained positional replay for this example. Native endpoint/counter evidence demonstrates severe inactivity, not the exact hypothetical positions or every causal transition.

model_biases_separate_from_blocker: Reject budget is health minus18% maxHP, while original fresh-pull affordability uses P_RESERVE_PCT=-60 (health plus60% maxHP); this is a major deliberate conservatism change, not an API error.

Forecast holds current contact geometry and helper positions constant across a full clear and counts a full hit on nearest-distance ties. It omits mitigation, shields, heals and dynamic tank rotation.

Helper inclusion requires actual healthy presence within basic range+1 of some group member. Two approaching claimers can both reject entry before either counts as help, while the presence of claims prevents fresh-solo target drop.

All helper DPS is assigned to the predicted clear order despite their possibly pursuing another target. Contact chooses a legal endpoint in a square but does not prove the actual pathfinder will use it.
Stationary fallback attacks only selected weakest camp; another camp can be in spell/basic reach without rescuing the selected out-of-range target.
decision: Treat focus-containing original-phase full packages as invalid for the correctness exception, preserve completed screen and incomplete full evidence, and predeclare any adaptive replacement phase before new source/outcome selection. Do not modify the frozen parent implementations.
